title: Fix E-Document purchase draft header Sub Total overwrite; notify on mismatch
summary: E-Document purchase draft no longer silently overwrites the header Sub Total when lines are edited. Users are now notified when the header total diverges from the line totals beyond a rounding tolerance, with options to dismiss or ignore future warnings.
key_points: Purchase draft header Sub Total is preserved from the incoming document instead of being recalculated
Added tolerance-based mismatch detection (rounding precision × line count) between header and line totals
Notifications appear on the purchase draft subform with Dismiss and Don't-show-again actions
Mismatch dismissal is persisted on the E-Document Purchase Header and re-arms when amounts are edited
Telemetry logging captures detected mismatches with totals, tolerance, and difference values
quote: The header total should be preserved, and the user should instead be warned when it diverges from the lines beyond a rounding tolerance.
